label: Personality trait name
summary: Text that gives the name of one personality trait, as that trait is called for the character.
details: It has 36 entries: one for each personality trait the keys name (arrogant, humble, lustful, chaste and so on) plus a 'notrait' entry. The texts shown give the trait's name as written for the character. The game marks it as not usable for a random pick.

label: Pet name
summary: Text for a pet name of affection such as "darling", "dearest" or "treasure".
details: It has 10 entries (darling, dearest, pet, treasure, sweetness, rose, sunshine, spring blossom, petal, honeycomb). The game allows a random pick, so a different name can appear each time.

label: Pet name (precious form)
summary: A set of 10 pet-name entries with a "precious" ending in their keys; the game shows no text for them here.
details: The entries mirror the PetName ones (darling, dearest, pet, treasure, ...). The input gives no text for any of them, so what they print is not known. One key, `pet_name_dearest_precious_precious`, has a doubled "precious" that looks like a typo in the game's own data.

label: Pet name with "my"

details: It has 9 entries; "dearest" is not among them. The game allows a random pick.

details: It has 11 entries, the ones of PetName plus "Morsel". Use it where the name starts a sentence. The game allows a random pick.

label: Possessed episode
